title: D-045 A1 wave 1: R1+R2 series height/setback draft rule families (numeric-limit districts, R5-pilot discipline)
objective: D-049 DEFINITIVE RESCOPE (owner decision: encode the 11-25 reading; supersedes the D-048 named-only scope for the five lettered variants - D-049-R006): encode the R1/R2 series height/setback draft rules as follows. (R001) R1-1, R1-2, R1-2A, R2A, R2X SHARE ZR 23-421 basic pitched-roof envelope (25 ft perimeter wall / 35 ft ridge) via ZR 11-25 suffix inheritance, each constraint carrying OWNER-DECISION provenance markers (never presented as an express per-variant citation) and DRAFT-until-G6 labels; bare R1 and R2 are encoded from the express 23-421 enumeration as before. (R002) R2X gets height parity - the 23-21 FAR row (1.00 vs 0.75) is a floor-area-only express exception and does NOT modify the height envelope; record this reasoning in the rule provenance. (R003) 23-421(g) encoded as an EXPLICIT CONDITIONAL per the owner-verified verbatim: eligible ONLY for no-letter-suffix districts (R1-1, R1-2, R2 eligible; R1-2A, R2A, R2X excluded), trigger (area >= 9,500 sq ft AND width >= 100 ft) OR slope >= 5 percent (either suffices); when a needed input is unavailable the rule emits an explicit assumption/review flag - NEVER silently applies or omits (g); the full sloping-plane setback geometry stays a typed A2 gap (D-045-R008). (R004) site-specific modifiers NEVER silent: 23-424 (evaluate the 12-10 qualifying-site definition, never assume), 23-425, 23-426(a), 23-443(b), 119-212, 113-523 each surface as conditions/flags/typed gaps; the pitched envelope is never rendered as a pitched-roof REQUIREMENT (23-413(a) alternative noted). (R005) every derived output carries owner-decision provenance + DRAFT-until-G6; the professional ask stays open in docs/ARCHITECT_REVIEW_QUESTIONS.md. Fail-closed everywhere; same pilot discipline (typed min/max, per-variant scoping + isolation tests, snapshot provenance).
